place.raw: Eccles, Metropolitan Borough of Salford, Greater Manchester, England

notes: LIKELY SPLIT-GENERATION DUPLICATE (research 2026-07-03): this record and I182625986581 ("Richard Valentine III," b.1615 Hempstead, d.1684 Elizabeth NJ) both feed into the same daughter, Mary Margaret Valentine, and both die in 1684 — likely one real immigrant split into two tree "generations." Independent sources (WikiTree Valentine-517, geni.com, freepages.rootsweb.com) describe a single immigrant Richard Valentine of Eccles Parish, Lancashire — one of the original 1644 Hempstead, Long Island proprietors (Townsman 1659, Overseer 1676, Constable 1679) — born c.1595, not 1610 as this record has it. His unrecorded 1682 will names a daughter "Mary, wife of Thomas Cheesman," corroborating the Mary Margaret Valentine → Thomas Cheesman/Cheeseman link.
